diversity_assessment: The same narrow range of long/oval face proportions, dark swept/curly hair, mild smiles, almost identical portrait poses and Roman architectural layouts persists. There is some beard/hair/skin-tone variation, but no visible broad diversity recovery in the fixed grid.
comparison_to_3000: No material quality-gate change. Minor changes in face contrast, mouth shape and backgrounds are visible, while the same conspicuous eye/cheek failures and stereotyped layout persist. The truncated view remains substantially more coherent than raw/untruncated; this does not establish reliable quality or unseen-latent generalization.
decision: Not approved for production. Retain this milestone as research evidence; observed improvement does not resolve malformed faces or narrow visual diversity.
